title: Byosahdi Vati
description: Byosahdi Vati (Vyoshadi Vati) is infused with Trikatu (Ginger, Black Pepper, Long Pepper) and soul-warming spices that clear stagnation in the respiratory passages. This classical formulation clears acute nasal running and congestion through its warming and decongesting action. Unblocked sinuses allow proper drainage and reduce the pressure that causes sinus headaches. Allergic rhinitis characterized by itchy nose, sneezing, and nasal congestion responds well to this formulation. Restores lost taste that often accompanies nasal congestion and respiratory infections. The warming spices promote healthy circulation in sinus tissues.
dosage: 1–2 tablets chewed slowly with warm water
